user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
For TX-0401 (EUR 240.00, TechMart Online, 2026-07-20, settled), there is no reason code stored on the transaction itself. The code depends on what went wrong. The available codes are:

| Reason code | Use when | Window (days from transaction date) |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | You were charged more than once for the same purchase | 60 |
| unauthorized_debit | You did not authorize the payment | 56 |
| fraud_card_not_present | Card used fraudulently for an online or phone payment | 120 |
| goods_not_received | You paid but did not receive the goods | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | You paid but the service was not provided | 90 |

Your account also shows a second TechMart Online charge of EUR 240.00 (TX-0402, 2026-07-14). If you were charged twice for one purchase, **duplicate_charge** is likely the right code. Based on the 60-day window, it would need to be opened by about 2026-09-18.

If you did not make either payment, **unauthorized_debit** or **fraud_card_not_present** may apply instead.

I have not opened a dispute. If you tell me which code fits, I will check eligibility first and then open it only if it is eligible.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
